data.command: Explain the manifestation gate in LOLM and why it matters

evidence.text: LOLM fuses five streams: surface decoder h, latent SSM z, regime layer r, persistent memory m, and a manifestation gate g that arbitrates surface vs latent per dimension.
The manifestation gate is a per-dimension sigmoid that arbitrates between the surface decoder and the latent SSM; trained models settle near g=0.72.
Inference-time component ablation at 304M: full LOLM 59.2 PPL; no regime layer +109 percent; no SSM +744 percent; no gate +905 percent; decoder only +3,612 percent. Every stream earns its place.
LOLM trains with 7 complementary losses: token cross-entropy, contrastive predictive coding, changepoint alignment, regime diversity, competitive gate, memory focus, and a gate regularizer.

It acts as a bridge between the heuristic and the latent machinery, allowing the agent to balance between the surface decoder and the latent SSM stream. The gate is a per-dimension sigmoid that arbitrates between the surface decoder and the latent SSM; trained models settle near g=0.72.
